question.text: Which of the following compounds can be detected by Molisch's test ?

solution.text: Molisch's Test : when a drop or two of alcoholic solution of $\alpha$-naphthol is added to sugar solution and then conc. $\mathrm{H}_2 \mathrm{SO}_4$ is added along the sides of test tube, formation of violet ring takes place at the junction of two liquids.
